objective: Travel to Frostwolf territory and search for Wing Commander Slidore, Wing Commander Vipore, and Wing Commander Ichman. Return to Commander Duffy should you complete your mission.

description: We got them held prisoner, <race>. I'm talking about their Wing Commanders. It was a furious battle in the skies but they finally fell! Unfortunately, our best pilots were shot down in a counterattack against Frostwolf Keep. You gotta find out what happened to them.
Search Tower Point West and Frostwolf Keep. These were their last known locations. Search these areas thoroughly.
progress: Anything I would care to hear?
completion: Unbelievable! You did free them, right? Right??? Well at the very least we know where they were held.
